verdict.rationale: Temporal has no documented built-in webhook trigger. The docs only show that a Temporal Client embedded in your own application can start Workflow Executions (temporal-docs-32), so a developer would have to build and host their own HTTP endpoint that calls the SDK client with the payload. Temporal's workflows-as-code positioning (temporal-docs-11) fits this do-it-yourself pattern, but it is not a native capability. Missing for 10: a native webhook/HTTP trigger URL, documented mapping of request payloads to workflow input, any webhook-specific docs or hands-on corroboration.
